title: Resultlist input configuration
description: Input of the resultlist component (data table), used both in `arlas.web.components.resultlists[]` and in `arlas.web.analytics[].components[]` with componentType `resultlist`. Rules extracted from the ARLAS WUI Builder export (`ConfigExportHelper.getAnalyticsComponent`) and import (`ResultListInputsFeeder`).

id.description: Identifier of the resultlist component. MUST be equal to the `contributorId` of the component (the Builder exports `id: contributorId`).

tableWidth.description: Width of the table in pixels. 445 for one widget per line, otherwise ceil(445 / itemPerLine) - 6 (217 for 2, 143 for 3; legacy exports used -12: 211 and 137). In the analytics panel, the Builder infers itemPerLine from this value at import.

searchSize.description: Page size of the list. Mirrors `search_size` of the resultlist contributor.

hasListView.description: MANDATORY. Whether the list (table) view is available. `true` when the contributor has at least one column; `false` otherwise.

hasCardView.description: MANDATORY, `false` when not used. Whether the card view is available. Must be `true` exactly when the contributor has at least one `cardViewProperties` entry (cards are built from them, one line per `lineNumber`).

hasGridView.description: MANDATORY, `false` when not used. Whether the grid view (tiles) is available. When `true`, the contributor fieldsConfiguration provides the tile content: `titleFieldNames[0]` (tile title), `tooltipFieldNames[0]` (tooltip), `iconColorFieldName` (tile color) and `urlThumbnailTemplate` (tile image, e.g. "https://host/{object_id}.jpg"); `urlImageTemplates` adds full-size quicklooks. Without urlThumbnailTemplate the tiles have no image.

defaultMode.description: View displayed at startup. `grid` requires `hasGridView: true`, `card` requires `hasCardView: true`; otherwise the Builder forces `list`. Legacy numeric values 0 (list), 1 (grid), 2 (card) are still parsed by `stringToResultlistModeEnum`.

displayFilters.description: Display a filter row below the column headers.

isGeoSortActived.description: Enable sorting the list by distance to the map center.

isAutoGeoSortActived.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

isExportEnabled.description: Enable the CSV export of the list.

isBodyHidden.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

cellBackgroundStyle.description: Background style of colorized cells. Only meaningful when at least one column of the contributor has `useColorService: true`.

useColorService.description: Use the ARLAS color service to colorize cells and icons. Always `true` in Builder exports.

nLastLines.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

detailedGridHeight.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

nbGridColumns.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

globalActionsList.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

selectedItemsEvent.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

consultedItemEvent.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

actionOnItemEvent.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

globalActionEvent.description: Passed through unchanged by the Builder (not editable).

downloadLink.description: URL template of a download service for an item.

visualisationLink.description: URL template of an external visualisation of an item.

visualisationsList.description: External visualisations available for the items.

options.description: Display options. The Builder always exports the full object.

showActionsOnhover.description: Show item actions on hover. Exported as the string 'true'.

showDetailIconName.description: Material icon used to open the details. Exported as 'keyboard_arrow_down'.

hideDetailIconName.description: Material icon used to close the details. Exported as 'keyboard_arrow_up'.

icon.description: Material icon of the list tab. Default 'short_text' at import.

showName.description: Show the list name in its tab. Default `true` at import.

showIcon.description: Show the icon in the list tab. Default `true` at import.

itemPerLine.description: Number of widgets per line in the analytics panel. Valid values: 1, 2, or 3. Default: 1
